mapper.sql: WITH pts AS ( SELECT emd_cd, ST_Transform(geom, 5179) AS g5 FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE lat IS NOT NULL AND lat BETWEEN 33.10 AND 33.65 AND lot BETWEEN 126.10 AND 127.00 AND cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' UNION ALL SELECT emd_cd, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lot::float8, lat::float8), 4326), 5179) AS g5 FROM parking.tb_pblpklt WHERE lat BETWEEN 33.10 AND 33.65 AND lot BETWEEN 126.10 AND 127.00 ), cells AS ( SELECT floor(ST_X(g5) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gx, floor(ST_Y(g5) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gy, count(*)::int AS pt_cnt, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY emd_cd) AS emd_cd FROM pts GROUP BY 1, 2 ), ctr AS ( SELECT c.gx, c.gy, c.pt_cnt, c.emd_cd, round(ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint( c.gx * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2, c.gy * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2), 5179), 4326))::numeric, 7) AS ctr_lat, round(ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint( c.gx * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2, c.gy * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2), 5179), 4326))::numeric, 7) AS ctr_lot FROM cells c )
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parking.tb_zone_nm_cache z WHERE z.lat_key = round(ctr.ctr_lat, 5) AND z.lot_key = round(ctr.ctr_lot, 5))
mapper.select: SELECT ctr.gx, ctr.gy, ctr.ctr_lat, ctr.ctr_lot, ad.emd_nm FROM ctr LEFT JOIN parking.tb_admdst ad ON ad.emd_cd = ctr.emd_cd WHERE ORDER BY ctr.pt_cnt DESC, ctr.gx, ctr.gy LIMIT #{limit}
